unit_numbering: Unit 1 at threshold 06; unit = 300 + 1 − unit_source (unit_source is the numbering of the MATLAB package, unit 1 at threshold 24).

axis.x_rule: x = distance along the runway axis from threshold 06 = 2999.304 − station.
axis.station_rule: station = distance along the runway axis from the outer edge of threshold 24; falls as the unit number rises.

g_rule.note: g_flag = governing BBI > 1.0 (strict). Stored for the SKG consequence axis; not used in the risk calculation yet.

corrections: ProFAA 3.1.0 export: "Distance (m)" is always 0; distance rebuilt from row order × 0.25 m (petakan_bbi_0624.m).
ProFAA 3.1.0 export: "Bump Height(m)" is 12× the true height (inches converted as feet); height recomputed as H = BBI × acceptable limit(L) (petakan_bbi_0624.m).
caveats: Line offsets are provisional: the L–R wheel-track spacing is unknown and the position of pass 1 relative to the runway centreline is unconfirmed. Offsets do not affect unit numbers, because each unit spans the full runway width.
The LCMS high-pass filter cutoff is unknown; the AC does not recommend high-passed inertial profiles for BBI (AC 150/5380-9 par. 2.2g).
Pass 22 of survey 2062903736 runs west but lies on the north side, unlike the other passes; it is not used until the surveyor confirms it.
